reference_method: Each FP32 activation times stored FP16 weight is evaluated as a separate FP64 product (at most35 significand bits, hence exactly representable); math.fsum reduces all1024products per output row. This is a local roundoff diagnostic, not full FP64 network inference or a replacement oracle.
limitations: All rows of layer0 Q/K/V for one identical captured input are evaluated; no handpicked channels.
Different FP32 reduction orders are allowed to differ; larger error here is not by itself a kernel bug.
Native captured SGEMM row and B1 dot row use the same input and weight values, but this local study does not prove the cause of later network error.
ULP distances are relative to rounded fsum results, not an invented acceptance threshold.
Optional NumPy matvec may use a different BLAS algorithm than native SGEMM.

archive_provenance.sanitization: Repository/home paths replaced; process and host identifiers removed. All comparisons and hashes retained.
